translation: Pochodzi od Casula. Powinieneś porozmawiać z Ericą.

source_text: Bring her here. We need to get to the bottom of this before you help Lillian. I don’t trust her, and you shouldn’t either.

structure.raw_value: BrBaOp.Bring her here. We need to get to the bottom of this before you help Lillian. I don’t trust her, and you shouldn’t either.
structure.script_literal: "BrBaOp.Bring her here. We need to get to the bottom of this before you help Lillian. I don’t trust her, and you shouldn’t either."

translation: Przyprowadź ją tutaj. Musimy to wyjaśnić, zanim pomożesz Lillian. Nie ufam jej i ty też nie powinieneś.

source_text: I know… I know… It’s hard to know what to do… It’s like my mind is being pulled in different directions.

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.I know… I know… It’s hard to know what to do… It’s like my mind is being pulled in different directions.
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.I know… I know… It’s hard to know what to do… It’s like my mind is being pulled in different directions."

translation: Wiem… Wiem… Trudno wiedzieć, co robić… Jakby coś ciągnęło mój umysł w różne strony.

source_text: You need to follow your heart, 1Hero. You’ve always been good at this kind of thing.

structure.raw_value: HeFrEx.You need to follow your heart, 1Hero. You’ve always been good at this kind of thing.
structure.script_literal: "HeFrEx.You need to follow your heart, 1Hero. You’ve always been good at this kind of thing."

translation: Powinieneś słuchać serca, 1Hero. Zawsze dobrze sobie radziłeś w takich sprawach.

source_text: Sister Judy, come with me…

structure.raw_value: BrBaEx.Sister Judy, come with me…
structure.script_literal: "BrBaEx.Sister Judy, come with me…"

source_text: I will keep you safe, and you can help me study.

structure.raw_value: BrFrEx.I will keep you safe, and you can help me study.
structure.script_literal: "BrFrEx.I will keep you safe, and you can help me study. "

translation: Zapewnię ci bezpieczeństwo, a ty pomożesz mi w nauce.

source_text: How many of those artifacts do you need to find, 1Hero?

structure.raw_value: BrBaOp.How many of those artifacts do you need to find, 1Hero?
structure.script_literal: "BrBaOp.How many of those artifacts do you need to find, 1Hero?"

translation: Ile jeszcze tych artefaktów musisz znaleźć, 1Hero?

source_text: I have four of them now, with one left in the mansion…

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.I have four of them now, with one left in the mansion…
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.I have four of them now, with one left in the mansion…"

translation: Mam już cztery, a jeden został w rezydencji…

source_text: There’s only one piece left to find.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.There’s only one piece left to find.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.There’s only one piece left to find."

translation: Został tylko jeden fragment do znalezienia.

source_text: If you find it, keep it secret.

structure.raw_value: BrBaEx.If you find it, keep it secret.
structure.script_literal: "BrBaEx.If you find it, keep it secret."

translation: Jeśli go znajdziesz, zachowaj to w tajemnicy.

source_text: This is crazy, 1Hero. It doesn't seem real.

structure.raw_value: HeWoOp.This is crazy, 1Hero. It doesn't seem real.
structure.script_literal: "HeWoOp.This is crazy, 1Hero. It doesn't seem real."

source_text: I know the thought. It was hard for me to believe, too.

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.I know the thought. It was hard for me to believe, too.
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.I know the thought. It was hard for me to believe, too."

translation: Rozumiem. Mnie też trudno było w to uwierzyć.

source_text: What should we tell Chloe?

structure.raw_value: HeSaOp.What should we tell Chloe?
structure.script_literal: "HeSaOp.What should we tell Chloe?"

source_text: Chloe already knows about the Toma Leolo.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.Chloe already knows about the Toma Leolo.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.Chloe already knows about the Toma Leolo."

translation: Chloe już wie o Tomie Leolo.

source_text: I meant about what we just did…

structure.raw_value: HeBaOp.I meant about what we just did…
structure.script_literal: "HeBaOp.I meant about what we just did…"

translation: Chodziło mi o to, co właśnie zrobiliśmy…

source_text: Oh, right. I don’t know… Maybe we should keep it a secret.

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.Oh, right. I don’t know… Maybe we should keep it a secret.
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.Oh, right. I don’t know… Maybe we should keep it a secret."

translation: Ach, racja. Nie wiem… Może powinniśmy zachować to w tajemnicy.

source_text: I don’t like keeping secrets.

structure.raw_value: HeSaOp.I don’t like keeping secrets.
structure.script_literal: "HeSaOp.I don’t like keeping secrets."

source_text: That was the last time, Heather… There’s nothing left to say.

structure.raw_value: McSaEx.That was the last time, Heather… There’s nothing left to say.
structure.script_literal: "McSaEx.That was the last time, Heather… There’s nothing left to say."

translation: To był ostatni raz, Heather… Nie ma już o czym mówić.

source_text: Isn’t there? The monster knew our innermost secrets.

structure.raw_value: HeSaDe.Isn’t there? The monster knew our innermost secrets.
structure.script_literal: "HeSaDe.Isn’t there? The monster knew our innermost secrets."

translation: Naprawdę? Potwór znał nasze najskrytsze sekrety.

source_text: Everyone has secrets, Heather.

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.Everyone has secrets, Heather.
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.Everyone has secrets, Heather."

source_text: I should go find the girls. I want to keep an eye on them.

structure.raw_value: HeBaEx.I should go find the girls. I want to keep an eye on them.
structure.script_literal: "HeBaEx.I should go find the girls. I want to keep an eye on them."

translation: Pójdę poszukać dziewczyn. Chcę mieć je na oku.

source_text: Don’t worry. Everything's going to be okay.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.Don’t worry. Everything's going to be okay.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.Don’t worry. Everything's going to be okay."

translation: Nie martw się. Wszystko będzie dobrze.

source_text: No sign of any books.

structure.raw_value: JuSaEx.No sign of any books.
structure.script_literal: "JuSaEx.No sign of any books."

translation: Nie ma śladu po żadnych książkach.

source_text: Could Father have put it in a storage box? Maybe it’s hidden.

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.Could Father have put it in a storage box? Maybe it’s hidden.
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.Could Father have put it in a storage box? Maybe it’s hidden."

translation: Czy ojciec mógł włożyć ją do pudła? Może jest ukryta.

source_text: We must leave no stone uncovered.

structure.raw_value: JuWoEx.We must leave no stone uncovered.
structure.script_literal: "JuWoEx.We must leave no stone uncovered."

source_text: Wow! I bet it costs a fortune to heat this place in the winter.

structure.raw_value: CaShOp.Wow! I bet it costs a fortune to heat this place in the winter.
structure.script_literal: "CaShOp.Wow! I bet it costs a fortune to heat this place in the winter."

translation: Wow! Ogrzanie tego miejsca zimą musi kosztować fortunę.

source_text: Yeah. The ceilings are very tall.

structure.raw_value: ChFrEx^.Yeah. The ceilings are very tall.
structure.script_literal: "ChFrEx^.Yeah. The ceilings are very tall."

source_text: It’s quite beautiful.

structure.raw_value: HeHaOp^.It’s quite beautiful.
structure.script_literal: "HeHaOp^.It’s quite beautiful."

source_text: I’ve already seen it!

structure.raw_value: HnAnDe.I’ve already seen it!
structure.script_literal: "HnAnDe.I’ve already seen it!"

source_text: Well, I haven’t, young lady!

structure.raw_value: CaAnEx.Well, I haven’t, young lady!
structure.script_literal: "CaAnEx.Well, I haven’t, young lady!"

translation: A ja jeszcze nie, młoda damo!

source_text: Wouldn’t you rather go alligator hunting?

structure.raw_value: HnSaEx.Wouldn’t you rather go alligator hunting?
structure.script_literal: "HnSaEx.Wouldn’t you rather go alligator hunting?"

translation: Wolałabyś nie pójść na polowanie na aligatory?

source_text: Chloe is showing us the cathedral. Show some manners.

structure.raw_value: CaAnEx.Chloe is showing us the cathedral. Show some manners.
structure.script_literal: "CaAnEx.Chloe is showing us the cathedral. Show some manners."

translation: Chloe oprowadza nas po katedrze. Zachowuj się przyzwoicie.

source_text: You don’t want to mess with an alligator.

structure.raw_value: ChWoCl^.You don’t want to mess with an alligator.
structure.script_literal: "ChWoCl^.You don’t want to mess with an alligator."

source_text: Yeah, I do!

structure.raw_value: HnAnEx.Yeah, I do!
structure.script_literal: "HnAnEx.Yeah, I do!"

source_text: Come on, Hannah. I’ll go into the woods with you.

structure.raw_value: HeFrEx^.Come on, Hannah. I’ll go into the woods with you.
structure.script_literal: "HeFrEx^.Come on, Hannah. I’ll go into the woods with you."

translation: Chodź, Hannah. Pójdę z tobą do lasu.

source_text: Be careful – there really is an alligator back there.

structure.raw_value: McWoEx.Be careful – there really is an alligator back there.
structure.script_literal: "McWoEx.Be careful – there really is an alligator back there."

source_text: Yeah. I guess we’ve had warmer weather this year.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.Yeah. I guess we’ve had warmer weather this year.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.Yeah. I guess we’ve had warmer weather this year."

translation: Tak. Chyba w tym roku było cieplej.

source_text: And a hell of a lot of storms.

structure.raw_value: CaBaEx.And a hell of a lot of storms.
structure.script_literal: "CaBaEx.And a hell of a lot of storms."

source_text: Come on, Carol. I’ll show you the view.

structure.raw_value: ChFrEx^.Come on, Carol. I’ll show you the view.
structure.script_literal: "ChFrEx^.Come on, Carol. I’ll show you the view."

source_text: Come with us, 1Hero! You can help us wrangle the gator.

structure.raw_value: HnHaEx.Come with us, 1Hero! You can help us wrangle the gator.
structure.script_literal: "HnHaEx.Come with us, 1Hero! You can help us wrangle the gator."

translation: Chodź z nami, 1Hero! Pomożesz nam złapać aligatora.

source_text: Don’t joke about that, Hannah. That thing will eat you.

structure.raw_value: McWoEx.Don’t joke about that, Hannah. That thing will eat you.
structure.script_literal: "McWoEx.Don’t joke about that, Hannah. That thing will eat you."

translation: Nie żartuj sobie, Hannah. To coś cię pożre.

source_text: Come on, Hannah. I want to see this alligator.

structure.raw_value: HeFrEx^.Come on, Hannah. I want to see this alligator.
structure.script_literal: "HeFrEx^.Come on, Hannah. I want to see this alligator."

translation: Chodź, Hannah. Chcę zobaczyć tego aligatora.

source_text: From a distance.

structure.raw_value: McWoEx.From a distance.
structure.script_literal: "McWoEx.From a distance."

source_text: Looking for something, 1Hero?

structure.raw_value: CaFlDe.Looking for something, 1Hero?
structure.script_literal: "CaFlDe.Looking for something, 1Hero?"

source_text: Don’t worry about it. Just detective work.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.Don’t worry about it. Just detective work.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.Don’t worry about it. Just detective work."

translation: Nie przejmuj się. Po prostu praca detektywa.

source_text: I can see a torn page up there. I wonder if I could throw something at it and knock it down.

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.I can see a torn page up there. I wonder if I could throw something at it and knock it down.
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.I can see a torn page up there. I wonder if I could throw something at it and knock it down."

translation: Widzę tam podartą kartkę. Ciekawe, czy mógłbym czymś w nią rzucić i strącić ją na dół.
